{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNS.Resolver where

import System.IO
import System.Directory
import System.FilePath
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word32)
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import System.Posix.Files (setFileMode, getFileStatus, fileMode)
import System.Posix.Types (FileMode)
import System.Posix.Temp (mkstemp)

-- Multi-tenant DNS cache with per-tenant isolation
data TenantId = TenantId { unTenantId :: String } deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { ceRecord   :: String
  , ceTTL      :: Word32
  , ceExpiry   :: Word32
  } deriving (Show, Read)

data ResolverConfig = ResolverConfig
  { rcCacheDir    :: FilePath
  , rcMaxEntries  :: Int
  , rcPermissions :: FileMode
  }

defaultConfig :: ResolverConfig
defaultConfig = ResolverConfig
  { rcCacheDir    = "/var/dns-cache"
  , rcMaxEntries  = 10000
  , rcPermissions = 0o600
  }

-- Validate tenant ID to prevent path traversal
validateTenantId :: TenantId -> Bool
validateTenantId (TenantId tid) =
  not (null tid) &&
  all (\c -> c `elem` (['a'..'z'] ++ ['0'..'9'] ++ ['-', '_'])) tid &&
  length tid <= 64 &&
  not (".." `isPrefixOf` tid)

-- Generate cache file path for a tenant
tenantCachePath :: ResolverConfig -> TenantId -> FilePath
tenantCachePath cfg tid = rcCacheDir cfg </> "tenant_" ++ unTenantId tid

-- Atomically persist cache to disk using temporary file
persistCache :: ResolverConfig -> TenantId -> [CacheEntry] -> IO (Either String ())
persistCache cfg tid entries =
  if not (validateTenantId tid)
    then return $ Left "Invalid tenant ID"
    else do
      let targetPath = tenantCachePath cfg tid
      -- Create temp file for atomic write using secure mkstemp
      result <- safeWriteCache targetPath entries (rcPermissions cfg)
      return result

-- Write cache data safely using mkstemp for unpredictable temp names
safeWriteCache :: FilePath -> [CacheEntry] -> FileMode -> IO (Either String ())
safeWriteCache targetPath entries perms = do
  -- mkstemp creates file with 0600 and unique unpredictable name
  (tempPath, h) <- mkstemp (targetPath ++ ".XXXXXX")
  hSetBuffering h LineBuffering
  mapM_ (\e -> hPutStrLn h (show e)) entries
  hFlush h
  hClose h
  -- Ensure restrictive permissions
  setFileMode tempPath perms
  -- Atomic rename
  renameFile tempPath targetPath
  return $ Right ()

-- Load cache from disk for a specific tenant
loadCache :: ResolverConfig -> TenantId -> IO (Either String [CacheEntry])
loadCache cfg tid =
  if not (validateTenantId tid)
    then return $ Left "Invalid tenant ID"
    else do
      let path = tenantCachePath cfg tid
      exists <- doesFileExist path
      if not exists
        then return $ Right []
        else do
          -- Verify file permissions before reading
          status <- getFileStatus path
          let mode = fileMode status
          if mode /= rcPermissions cfg
            then return $ Left "Cache file has unexpected permissions"
            else do
              contents <- readFile path
              let entries = map read (lines contents)
              return $ Right entries

-- Evict expired entries during cache maintenance
maintenanceSweep :: ResolverConfig -> TenantId -> IO (Either String Int)
maintenanceSweep cfg tid = do
  now <- round <$> getPOSIXTime :: IO Word32
  cacheResult <- loadCache cfg tid
  case cacheResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right entries -> do
      let valid = filter (\e -> ceExpiry e > now) entries
      let evicted = length entries - length valid
      when (evicted > 0) $ do
        _ <- persistCache cfg tid valid
        return ()
      return $ Right evicted

-- Resolve a DNS query with caching
resolveWithCache :: ResolverConfig -> TenantId -> String -> IO (Either String String)
resolveWithCache cfg tid query = do
  cacheResult <- loadCache cfg tid
  case cacheResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right entries -> do
      now <- round <$> getPOSIXTime :: IO Word32
      case filter (\e -> ceRecord e == query && ceExpiry e > now) entries of
        (hit:_) -> return $ Right (ceRecord hit)
        []      -> do
          -- Simulate upstream resolution
          let result = "RESOLVED:" ++ query
          let newEntry = CacheEntry result 300 (now + 300)
          _ <- persistCache cfg tid (newEntry : take (rcMaxEntries cfg - 1) entries)
          return $ Right result
